name: spending-steps-glide-healthcare-survivor
description: Couple retiring together in 2028 (62 and 60): spending steps by the first person's age (70, 80, and 85 after their death), −1% real glide from the first retirement year, a $12k pre-Medicare line while a living retiree is under 65, 25% survivor reduction from the first death; 2.5% inflation, start-of-year withdrawals (§5).

capitalMarket.note: Illustrative round-number assumptions chosen by the app authors; not a forecast.
